Liam — thanks for the context and the rough target. Attached is a first-pass MPA spreadsheet (SatelliteCare_MPA_v3.xlsx). Top-level sequencing proposal below — aim is to create parallel lanes to shorten calendar time while preserving legal review quality.

Proposed sprint (week numbers relative to kickoff):
- Week 0 (today): Confirm final procurement owner + GC contact.
- Week 1: Redwood to provide clean MSA + DPA; SatelliteCare to provide any security questionnaire updates.
- Week 2: Legal redlines exchanged; Redwood to accept or counter high-priority clauses.
- Week 3: Finalize Order Form pricing and acceptance criteria; Finance sign-off.
- Week 4: Signatures and DocuSign routing (MSA then Order Form; DPA either executed concurrently or as addendum depending on redlines).

Key dependencies / gating items:
- Security questionnaire: full completion needed for production data access. (If not done, we can do a scoped pilot with synthetic data.)
- DPA: If SatelliteCare insists on a fully negotiated DPA prior to signature, that will add ~3 business days.
- Order Form pricing approval from SatelliteCare FP&A is required before DocuSign routing.

Asks for SatelliteCare: please confirm procurement owner (Rosa?), GC contact for redlines, and whether your procurement team can accept Redwood's standard DPA addendum model.

I'll loop-in Karthik for acceptance criteria on our side and Markus for legal-facing questions. If everyone aligns, I'll push a revised MPA and a condensed checklist (evidence + who owns what) by end of day tomorrow.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan

Maya — good sketch. A few practical sequencing recommendations from legal/ops:

- Parallel track: Accepting redlines in parallel with procurement pricing reduces calendar time. We should treat the Order Form as the commercial gating doc (price + acceptance), and the MSA as the legal umbrella — get MSA marked up but allow signature swap if critical path requires.
- DPA handling: propose DPA as a separate addendum to the MSA. That lets us ship a lightweight DPA for pilot data scopes and treat broader DPA negotiations as a post-signature attachment if necessary.
- Evidence pack: attach DPA-Evidence-Checklist.docx to the MPA and have SatelliteCare confirm SOC2 + encryption standards in Week 1.

If SatelliteCare requires their GC sign-off before any signature, push their expected date earlier; otherwise we can maintain the 4-week sprint. I'll prepare the legal notes for Maya's MPA worksheet — will attach quick redline guidance by EOD.

-Markus
